verdict: Yes, for a team focused on fleets. Otua from Gurgaon pitched an e-mobility solution with patented battery technology on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Electric three-wheelers are already the majority of new three-wheeler sales in many areas, and drivers and fleets care about running cost and reliability.
angle: E-rickshaws and electric autos are cheaper to run than CNG or diesel. Fleets and drivers want reliable batteries and financing. Battery swapping can reduce upfront cost.
